params.body:
## What

Laravel 13.32.0 → **13.38.0**, the latest stable 13.x, together with every Composer package that can move inside the constraints `composer.json` already sets (`composer update -W`, 81 lock entries plus 1 new one). `composer.json` itself is unchanged.

Notable moves:

| Package | From | To |
|---|---|---|
| laravel/framework | 13.32.0 | 13.38.0 |
| laravel/fortify | 1.39.0 | 1.41.0 |
| laravel/passport | 13.8.0 | 13.10.0 |
| laravel/telescope | 5.20.0 | 5.26.0 |
| laravel/nightwatch | 1.28.5 | 1.30.4 |
| livewire/livewire | 4.4.5 | 4.4.7 |
| maatwebsite/excel | 4.0.2 | 4.0.4 |
| mollie/laravel-mollie | 4.1.1 | 4.1.2 |
| symfony/* | 8.1.5–8.1.7 | 8.1.8–8.1.9 (symfony/filesystem 7.4 → 8.1) |
| brick/math (via framework) | 0.19.1 | 1.0.0 |
| phpunit/phpunit | 12.5.35 | 12.5.40 |
| phpstan/phpstan, larastan | 2.2.14, 3.12.1 | 2.3.1, 3.13.0 |

## Code changes

- `MergeDuplicateModels`: the four-closure `sortBy([...])` is now one `sort()` comparator over a tuple (live vehicles, weight, active, id). Same order: PHP compares arrays element by element. Larastan 3.13 types the closures in a multi-key `sortBy` as `(TValue, TKey)`, so `$b` became `int` and the job failed. `MergeDuplicateModelsTest` covers the ranking.
- `TheVehicleSheetOpensOnlyForItsOwnGarageTest`: Livewire 4.4.7's test broker now hands `ModelNotFoundException` to the exception handler (as it already did for `HttpException`), so `Livewire::test()` on another garage's vehicle returns the 404 page instead of throwing. The test now asserts `assertStatus(404)`. Checked that the component really refuses (404 page, no vehicle state), not that the guard got weaker. Worth knowing: with `OwnVehicle::fromKeyOrFail` taken out of `mount()`, this test stays green both before and after this PR, because `render()` refuses through `ownVehicle()` too. The protection is real, but this test alone does not pin the guard in `mount()`.
- `phpstan-baseline.neon`: five existing entries rewritten to the messages PHPStan 2.3 now gives for the same lines (`Collection<(int|string), …>` is now `Collection<int, …>`, two "always true" checks are now reported as `filled()` narrowing, one count 2 → 1). No new debt; the lines themselves are untouched.

## Migrations

None. The package migrations of Passport, Telescope and Fortify are byte-identical between the old and new versions, and no package config the app publishes changed. Nightwatch's own default for `server` moved from `gethostname()` in the config file to the service provider; the result is the same, and the app does not publish that config.

## Breaking changes

None expected for the running app: every Laravel package moves inside its major. For tests: `Livewire::test()` no longer throws `ModelNotFoundException` (see above); a new test of a refusal asserts the status. Two transitive majors come with it: `brick/math` 1.0 (used by the framework, not by `app/`) and `symfony/filesystem` 8.1 (pulled by the rest of Symfony 8.1). Laravel 13.38 also moved the `/up` health route into a `HealthCheck` class; this app does not register that route.

## Left out on purpose

- Package majors outside the constraints: `intervention/image` 2 → 4, `mollie/laravel-mollie` 4 → 5, `openai-php/client` 0.10 → 0.21, `phpunit/phpunit` 12 → 13, `spatie/array-to-xml` 2 → 3. Each changes an API the app calls (photos, payments, OpenAI, XML feeds to partners) and deserves its own PR and its own test round.
- npm. `npm update` with this npm rewrote 2,300 lines of `package-lock.json` and dropped the optional peer entries (`sass`, `terser`, `@parcel/watcher`) again, for patch-level tooling bumps (vite 8.3.4, vitest 5.0.5, eslint 10.13). The front-end majors (Bootstrap 5, Tailwind 4, jQuery 4) are UI work, not a dependency bump.

## Checks run locally

- `phpunit` full suite: 3137 tests, 0 failures (2 skipped, 1 incomplete, 9 PHPUnit notices), on a freshly built test database
- `phpstan analyse`: no errors
- `pint --test` on the changed PHP: passed
- `composer audit`: no advisories
- `npm run build`, `vitest` (103 passed), `eslint` (0 errors, 30 warnings, at the limit), npm audit ceiling 6: passed

## Risk

Low to moderate. Six framework minors in one go; the areas worth a glance after deploy are login (Fortify, passkeys), the Passport API used by partners, and Livewire lists (OwnStockList). Nightwatch will show errors within minutes if anything regressed.

## Rollback

Revert this PR and redeploy: Forge runs `composer install` from the reverted `composer.lock`, which restores the exact previous versions. No database or config step is involved, so a revert is complete on its own.
